research_state.review_conclusion: The complete memorial page names Nancy with mother Mary Bell and names her husband William of Killycorragh, farmer/businessman, followed by eight children. Mary Bell is Nancy’s mother, not William’s parent. No father or Glasgow sibling is stated for William. The known children and their separately qualified adult identities cannot create an earlier generation. The life course remains the Ohio emigrant, not the London/Hull physician. Retain unknown and unrated; no father candidate invented.
